interior_connectivity_diagnostic.scope: Additional interior connectivity; does not replace failure at the initial origin.
interior_connectivity_diagnostic.selection: First baseline checkpoint whose 22 cm footprint is free in every map, including H.

agent_diagnosis.result: Modest internal-consistency improvement for E; no demonstrated across-criteria superiority over saved historical map, pending human inspection.

hypotheses.finding: Identical raw grids, ancestral trajectory and PGM. Numerical optimization preserves estimates.
Doubling particles alone does not materially improve consistency; withheld endpoint fraction decreases slightly.
Tighter prior does not reproduce the substantial Cafe gain. Withheld P95 increases relative to B. Possible reliance on imperfect physical odometry; hypothesis only.
Smaller proposal sampling improves integrated and withheld endpoint tails in this seed. Not yet robust across seeds.

visual_observations: Historical and replay maps preserve the room contour and three table rows.
E looks slightly cleaner in parts of the upper wall; differences are small.
Irregular table edges and the narrow fan of observed space at the upper opening persist.
Native-frame global rotation/translation differences are not physical deformation or accuracy measurements.
agent_diagnosis.navigation: Origin footprint blocked at 22 cm in every map. From the same common safe interior seed, all admissible checkpoints are in one component; total accepted checkpoints H83/181, A/B89/181, C/D/E88/181. Different estimated trajectories and footprint validity are not ground truth.
agent_diagnosis.timing: Large host-load change during C, then slower D/E. Keep actual full distributions but do not attribute the difference to prior/sample parameters or certify 1x ROS throughput.
agent_diagnosis.next_step_requires_human_review: Inspect H/B/E wall and table details before choosing finalists or planning new seeds/controlled ROS validation.
